title.zh: BitMine adds 12,532 ETH, says buying largely complete
title.en: BitMine adds 12,532 ETH, says buying largely complete

current_state.zh: BitMine acquired another 12,532 ETH to reach 6,028,946 ETH (~4.9% of Ethereum's supply, 99% of its 5% target, with 5.07M ETH staked) and said it is largely done buying ETH.
